title: Care Centre Guidance: Comfort Club Members and the Labor-Only Claim Service Fee
content:
**The rule.** On a Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection or Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection contract of Harbison Protection Contracts, the claim service fee for a service call carries a member fee share. The member fee share is set by the holder's Comfort Club agreement in active status on the date of handling, read against the completed date of the service call. The agreement, its status, its term dates, whether its Comfort Club tier waives the warranty claim service fee and how many consecutive terms it has been held are read from the holder's Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements record.

- Such an agreement whose term covers that date, at a tier that waives the claim service fee, takes a member fee share of zero, so that no fee is charged.
- Such an agreement whose term covers that date, at a tier that does not waive the fee, held for three or more consecutive terms, takes the loyal-member fee share of 0.50.
- Any other holder takes a member fee share of one.

The member fee share applies by multiplication to the fee for the call.

**Truth table.**

| Agreement in active status on the date of handling | Its term covers the call's completed date | Tier waives the claim service fee | Consecutive terms held | Member fee share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | any | 0 (no fee charged) |
| yes | yes | no | 3 or more | 0.50 |
| yes | yes | no | 1 or 2 | 1 |
| yes | no | any | any | 1 |
| no | — | — | — | 1 |

**Points of judgement (hypothetical).**

- The call was completed on 12 January 2026; the holder's active agreement runs 1 March 2025 to 28 February 2026 at a tier without the waiver, in its fourth consecutive term: the term covers the completed date, so the share is 0.50.
- Same holder, but the call was completed on 20 February 2025, before the current term began: the term does not cover the completed date, so the share is 1.
- A holder whose agreement lapsed before the date of handling holds no agreement in active status: share 1.
